subject: VIP ground ops, shuttle manifest, and AV operator handoff for Synnexa workshop
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hayes <emily.hayes@synnexa.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Site access windows, VIP shuttle plan, and AV operator handoff — workshop 04/12

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for confirming the 12 Apr exec workshop at The Grove. A few coordination items from our side so we can lock the logistics and pass final artifacts to OnPoint (vendor):

- Arrival windows: we need confirmed VIP arrival windows for three execs (A/B/C) between 08:00–10:00 so we can schedule the shuttle and front-of-house credentialing.
- Shuttle: we plan two 16-seat shuttles + one 6-seat SUV for overflow/VIP luggage. Can you confirm driveway dropoff location and loading bay access times? I attached the latest site_floorplan_v2.pdf with proposed curbside spots.
- AV operator handoff: our AV crew needs a 45-minute dry-run window and secure access to the A/V rack. See operator-checklist.pdf — please confirm an on-site contact to meet the operator.
- Credentialing & badges: we’ll bring printed guest lists but need a single point to sign in VIPs and return badges—who on your side will staff registration?

Attachments: site_floorplan_v2.pdf

Can you confirm the above by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize transport & AV operator scheduling?

Thanks,

Mateo Alvarez
Senior Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Emily Hayes <emily.hayes@synnexa.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Robins <jordan.robins@onpointvenues.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Site access windows, VIP shuttle plan, and AV operator handoff — workshop 04/12

Hi Mateo,

Thanks — this looks good. Quick answers:

- VIP arrivals: Exec A 08:15, Exec B 09:05, Exec C 09:30. All will use the east driveway dropoff (marked on your plan as Curb B).
- Loading bay access: vendor load-in opens at 06:30; C-level vehicle access allowed between 07:45–10:00. No oversized trucks after 07:00 due to morning deliveries.
- Registration: I’ll staff registration until 10:30; Jordan Robins (cc’d) is OnPoint’s lead and will meet your AV operator.
- Security: Building requires IDs for badge issuance; attached is the site_access_guide.pdf with security procedures.

I’ve looped Jordan — he’ll confirm operator arrival window and bring the OnPoint contact list.

Emily

Emily Hayes
Events & Partnerships | Synnexa Financial
emily.hayes@synnexa.com
Attachments: site_access_guide.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Emily Hayes <emily.hayes@synnexa.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Site access windows, VIP shuttle plan, and AV operator handoff — workshop 04/12

Thanks Emily — useful details. A few AV operational notes so OnPoint and our operator are aligned:

- Dry-run window: 07:00–07:45 (we’ll aim for earlier given your vendor load-in at 06:30).
- Rack access: IT closet door requires security escort; OnPoint must be on-site by 06:50 so our tech can handoff keys and test KVM.
- Conference bridge: we’ll deploy redundant PSTN trunk + WebRTC bridge for backup. Jordan, please provide trunk DID for test calls.
- Mic plan: for exec roundtable we need 3 boundary mics + 2 lapels; please confirm wireless frequency clearance with venue tech.

I attached operator-checklist.pdf with timing and test call checklist — please confirm Jordan and OnPoint can meet those times.

- Action: Mateo to finalize shuttle manifest and provide driver arrival contact.

Kimberly Park
Lead AV & Production | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: operator-checklist.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hayes <emily.hayes@synnexa.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Site access windows, VIP shuttle plan, and AV operator handoff — workshop 04/12

Morning team — draft shuttle manifest attached (shuttle_manifest.xlsx). Notes:

- Drivers: Two vendors — Parkline Transit (primary) and Redwood Logistics (backup). Contact names/phones are in the manifest.
- VIP SUV: reserved for Exec A; driver will hold a laminated name card at the east driveway.
- Luggage policy: drivers will stage at Loading Bay #2 and ferries will be limited to two trips per vehicle between 07:30–09:30.
- MSA & vendor insurance: Emily, I sent a DocuSign powerform link for the OnPoint MSA; Jordan, please sign/up OnPoint to the powerform so insurance info is recorded.

Attachments: shuttle_manifest.xlsx

Next steps:
- Jordan to confirm operator check-in at 06:50
- OnPoint to provide PSTN DID for test calls
- Emily to confirm badge staffing and final exec names for manifest by 03/24

Thanks,
Mateo

From: Jordan Robins <jordan.robins@onpointvenues.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Emily Hayes <emily.hayes@synnexa.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Site access windows, VIP shuttle plan, and AV operator handoff — workshop 04/12

Hi all — Jordan from OnPoint here. Confirming:

- OnPoint operator Sam Cho will be on-site at 06:45 for key handoff (Sam mobile: +1 213-555-9876).
- We’ll provide PSTN trunk DID for test call by 03/24 (will send separate email to Kimberly with details).
- Parking & staging: confirm that the 6-seat SUV can access Loading Bay #2 at 07:00 for luggage drop; we’ll fold into driver POC.
- I’ll sign the DocuSign powerform today and upload insurance certificate.

Looking forward — see you all on 04/12.

Jordan Robins
Director, Venue Ops | OnPoint Venues
jordan.robins@onpointvenues.com
Attachments: none
